meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, clean, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把动画帧脚本渲染成成片视频,并发布到云端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把动画或视频素材批量渲染成片并发布到云端
copy.tagline_en: Render animation frames into finished videos and publish them to the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render animated compositions into finished videos and ship them at scale

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你搭建、编写和检查视频项目:初始化脚手架、搜索并安装现成动效、预览时间线、渲染成片。需要 Node.js 22 及以上和 FFmpeg。
howto.when: 当你要搭建、编写或渲染 HyperFrames 视频项目,或排查构建、渲染失败时触发。可从本地、HeyGen 云端、AWS Lambda 等环境渲染。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes 初始化一个新视频项目
say.note: 会运行 init 建出居中的空白项目

say.text: 帮我搜一下有没有标题逐行出现的现成动效
say.note: 会用 catalog 搜索,可再用 add 安装

say.text: 检查一下这个项目能不能正常渲染
say.note: 会先跑 check,再开预览等你确认

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the HyperFrames CLI through npx hyperframes to scaffold, author and check video projects: init, catalog search, add, preview and render. Requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build, author or render a HyperFrames video project, or diagnose build and render failures. Rendering covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new HyperFrames video project for me
say_en.note: Runs init to create a centered blank project

say_en.text: Find an existing animation that reveals a headline line by line
say_en.note: Uses catalog search; add installs it

say_en.text: Check whether this project can render properly
say_en.note: Runs check, then opens preview for approval
